title: Fuzzy Logic Systems
lead: Covers: why fuzzy logic (vague human assessments, Zadeh 1965, the Sendai subway), crisp vs fuzzy sets, terminology (membership function, linguistic variable, hedge), fuzzy propositional logic, union / intersection / complement, fuzzy rules and system components, fuzzification and membership functions (triangular, trapezoidal, L/R, Gaussian), Mamdani and Sugeno inference, defuzzification by centre of gravity, and two worked controllers. No prior lecture attendance needed.
